definitions: A simplifying representation used in natural language processing and information retrieval.
A model that represents text (such as a sentence or a document) as a multiset of its words, disregarding grammar and even word order but keeping multiplicity.
examples: The Bag-of-Words Model is fundamental in text classification.
Understanding the Bag-of-Words Model helps in feature extraction.
Many early spam filters relied on the Bag-of-Words Model.
